question: Which unusual flavour is observed in dairy products due to the formation of ethyl esters catalysed by esterases produced by lactic acid bacteria?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fruity flavour**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** formation of ethyl esters in dairy products, catalyzed by esterases produced by lactic acid bacteria, results in a fruity flavor**.
 
• This** process is called esterification**. 
 
• Esterases **are enzymes that can both synthesize and hydrolyze esters.** <
